gloss: blocked in all directions; at a dead end

definitions.gloss: blocked in all directions; at a dead end; no way out
definitions.explanation: A situation where all options are exhausted and there is no apparent solution or escape route.

examples.japanese: {八方塞|はっぽうふさ}がりの{状況|じょうきょう}だ。
examples.english: It's a situation where I'm blocked in all directions.

examples.japanese: {借金|しゃっきん}で{八方塞|はっぽうふさ}がりになった。
examples.english: I ended up at a dead end because of debt.

examples.japanese: {八方塞|はっぽうふさ}がりに{思|おも}えても、{必|かなら}ず{道|みち}はある。
examples.english: Even when it seems like there's no way out, there's always a path.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{八方|はっぽう} (all eight directions) + {塞|ふさ}がり (blocked) - blocked in all directions. From Chinese cosmology where eight directions cover all possible paths.
Originally a term from {陰陽道|おんみょうどう} (onmyodo) referring to a year when all directions are inauspicious for travel or action.

USAGE:
Describes:
- Financial troubles with no solution
- Relationship problems with no escape
- Work situations with no options
- General feeling of being trapped

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {八方塞|はっぽうふさ}がりになる - to become blocked in all directions
- {八方塞|はっぽうふさ}がりの{状態|じょうたい} - state of being at a dead end

RELATED WORDS:
- {行|い}き{詰|づ}まり - deadlock, impasse
- {板挟|いたばさ}み - caught between two sides
